scripts.dev: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend python -m dive_trip.bootstrap.local serve
scripts.start: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend python -m dive_trip.bootstrap.local serve --production
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend python -m dive_trip.bootstrap.local migrate
scripts.data:expire: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend python -m dive_trip.bootstrap.local retention
scripts.typecheck: node tests/support/next-command.ts typegen && tsc --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend python -m dive_trip.bootstrap.contracts src/contracts/generated.ts
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend python -m dive_trip.bootstrap.contracts src/contracts/generated.ts --check
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/src
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --frozen --no-sync --project backend ruff check backend/src backend/tests
